summary.headline: Planetary Configurations and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological judgments on planets placed in one another’s signs or houses, describing effects on marriage, health, children, lawsuits, commerce, labor, fame, and profit. The passage also discusses Saturn on the ascendant, chronocrators, diametrical opposition, and planetary joys, including Mars’s relation to Cypris.
